# LobbyDuo

> LobbyDuo is an independent web tool at migosai.design for creating Hotel Lobby–style duo performance videos from two photos and Ozil goal–style football clips from one photo. Users can choose a stage, model, sound and motion reference. Google sign-in and sufficient generation credits are required. LobbyDuo is not affiliated with migosai.com, Migos, Quavo, Takeoff, Quality Control Music or COLORS.

## Ozil Goal facts
- Input: one photo of one consenting adult, ideally head to toe with the face visible. JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB. No prompt or editing.
- Output: a 15-second vertical 9:16 MP4 with sound at 768p, generated with MiniMax H3 from a fixed motion reference.
- Each Ozil video costs 300 credits from the same balance used by the other LobbyDuo generators, so the 300-credit Starter pack covers one Ozil video. Failed generations return credits. Generation time varies.
- The sample video on the page is an original reference sample made from an AI-generated portrait, not a customer result. Movement, timing, clothing and identity vary between renders; keeping your own clothes is likely, not guaranteed.
- LobbyDuo does not add its own watermark to Ozil videos. LobbyDuo is not affiliated with Mesut Özil or any player, club, league, federation or broadcaster. Do not upload footballers, celebrities, public figures, children or anyone who has not agreed.

## Product facts
- Two separate images are used, one for each performer. JPG, PNG and WebP are accepted, up to 10 MB each.
- Models: Wan 3.0, Seedance 2.0 and Seedance 2.0 Fast. Stages: Hotel Lobby, Luxury lobby, Recording studio and Street cypher. Wan uses the Hotel Lobby stage; the other stages use Seedance original audio.
- Template duration choices: 5, 8, 10, 12 or 15 seconds. Uploaded motion clips can determine duration within the selected model's limits. Aspect ratios: 9:16, 16:9, 1:1, 4:3 or 3:4. Resolutions: 480p, 720p or 1080p; Seedance Fast supports up to 720p.
- Sound choices: template soundtrack, an uploaded song, audio extracted from a motion clip, or original AI rap with an optional topic. Browsers prepare the selected short segment before uploading it. References guide generation; exact audio copying or identical movement is not guaranteed.
- The default Wan template video is 10 seconds at 480p and costs 60 credits. A 5-second 480p template video costs 30 credits with Wan, 50 with Seedance or 40 with Seedance Fast. Wan charges for reference-video plus output duration; the server calculates the final quote from validated media metadata.
- New accounts start with 0 credits. Registration and sign-in do not grant credits. Purchase a one-time credit pack before generating; existing account balances remain available. No subscription or automatic renewal is required. No daily free-video allowance is offered. Check the generator's quote before submitting.
- LobbyDuo does not add its own watermark. This does not guarantee that source material or provider output contains no marks.
- Processing includes upload, generation and review. Video duration is not a promise about completion time.
- New video requests use Kie. APIMart processes music and historical video jobs. SeeAPI reviews generated video results before delivery; this is not a claim that every prompt or uploaded image is screened.
- Upload only authorized material with the consent of each person depicted. Unauthorized celebrity or public-figure impersonation and misleading endorsements are prohibited.
- Support, refunds, privacy requests, and content reports: cuilinhao2021@gmail.com.

## FAQ
- Q: Can I generate a complete Hotel Lobby AI video for free here? A: No. New accounts receive no free credits. Purchase a one-time credit pack and check that your balance covers the selected settings before generating. The default 10-second Wan template costs 60 credits. Existing account balances remain available.
- Q: Do I need to write a prompt? A: No. Scene instructions are built in. For original AI rap, a topic is optional.
- Q: Do both people need to appear in one photo? A: No. Add one photo per performer to the two upload slots.
- Q: Is this an official artist or COLORS product? A: No. LobbyDuo is an independent tool; descriptive references do not imply affiliation or endorsement.
- Q: Is LobbyDuo the same as migosai.com? A: No. LobbyDuo runs at migosai.design and is operated independently of migosai.com and any other similarly named service.

Content reviewed: 2026-10-15. Check the linked pages and generator for current settings and costs.
